people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Nathan
people.line: Prophet during the reigns of David and Solomon.

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

people.name: Zadok
people.line: High priest during the reigns of David and Solomon

translations.web: Let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel. Blow the trumpet, and say, ‘Long live king Solomon!’
translations.bsb: There Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet are to anoint him king over Israel. You are to blow the ram’s horn and declare, ‘Long live King Solomon!’
translations.kjv: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel: and blow ye with the trumpet, and say, God save king Solomon.
translations.asv: and let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel; and blow ye the trumpet, and say, Long live king Solomon.
